scope: Explicit analyst-selected scientific comparisons of freshwater E.coli, measured chlorophyll a and measured cyanotoxins; no automatic health or compliance determination.

policy.parameterMatching: Exact case-normalized declared aliases only; no substring, taxonomy, nutrient-to-pathogen, or pigment-to-toxin inference.
policy.unitMatching: Only explicit entries; blank units are ineligible. A factor of1 never relabels MPN as CFU or merges methods.
policy.scientificScope: Comparisons to an analyst-selected profile. Never label regulatory compliance, safe swimming, waterbody closure, drinking-water safety or causation.
policy.temporalBasis: Retain profile edition and collection date. Current-edition comparisons of older samples are reference comparisons unless historical applicability is separately established.
policy.routineActivity: Retain every input row. Default analytical cohort is Sample-Routine. A field replicate is separate quality-control evidence, not an additional independent routine sample; its original identity remains visible.
policy.dates: Use the recorded local sample date. Parse qualified EDT as UTC−04:00 and EST as UTC−05:00 only when the source actually supplies them; retain original tokens. Missing or conflicting clocks cannot establish24-hour spacing.
policy.rollingWindows: For a30-day sampled endpoint window, include endpoint local date and preceding29 local dates. Display start/end and selected row IDs. Evaluate every sampled endpoint, not arbitrary resampled grids.
policy.seasonalBoundaries: Do not use one season's threshold for samples from another season. A window crossing a criteria-season boundary has partial seasonal support and cannot establish a complete homogeneous30-day comparison without an explicitly reviewed assessment method.

censoring.provenance: Conservative application rules, not a replacement agency assessment methodology.
censoring.source: Preserve source_value_token, bound value/unit/type, result detection condition, result status, qualifier, reporting limit and raw row.
censoring.exact: Use the original positive exact numeric result for geometric means only when no source qualifier contradicts exactness.
censoring.bounds: For strict threshold exceedance x>T, classify as certain above only if every possible value allowed by the original interval exceeds T; certain not above only if every allowed value is <=T; otherwise indeterminate. Preserve open/closed bounds.
censoring.gm: Do not silently discard censored, zero, negative or missing selected samples. The exact geometric-mean comparison is unsupported if any included sample is not a strictly positive exact value; a separately labelled descriptive eligible subset may be shown with its exclusions.
censoring.fraction: Retain every otherwise eligible sampled result in the denominator. Report [certain_exceedances/N,(certain_exceedances+indeterminate)/N]; compare to the allowed fraction only when this interval establishes a conclusion. Zero denominator is unsupported.
censoring.unqualifiedDetection: NotDetected needs an actual bound before quantitative use; NotReported is missing; Present Below/Above Quantification Limit is not an exact result merely because a numeric cell exists.

policy.support: Report applicability, method compatibility, temporal coverage, minimum count and spacing separately from the numeric comparison. Unknown applicability or unsupported aggregation must not become below threshold.
policy.equality: Threshold exceedance is strictly greater than, not greater-than-or-equal. Never round before comparison.
policy.geometricMean: 10**(sum(log10(x))/N) for strictly positive exact samples, using the corrected2014 EPA definition; preserve precision and identify numerical tolerance rather than moving the threshold.
noUnmeasuredInference: E.coli indicator counts do not identify a pathogenic strain or illness.
Chlorophyll a does not establish cyanotoxin concentration.
Cyanobacterial presence or cell density does not establish microcystins or cylindrospermopsin.
Absence of a measured toxin result is not evidence that toxin is absent.
